Safety & IEM Listening Notice

  • Epilepsy & Seizure Warning: Do not use brainwave entrainment or visual patterns if you have epilepsy, a history of seizures, or photosensitive conditions. Rhythmic visual pulsing is kept OFF by default.
  • Never Use While Driving: Do not listen while driving, cycling, or operating machinery.
